item.title: From Machine Operators to Managers, Manufacturers Shift Hiring Priorities
item.description: ATLANTA— Manufacturers are entering 2026 facing a tightening labor market marked by an aging workforce, persistent skills gaps and hundreds of thousands of unfilled jobs.

item.title: New California Fee Targets Products with Nonremovable Batteries
item.description: SACRAMENTO, Calif.—Products with nonremovable batteries are the target of a new state recycling fee structure in California that expands the state’s electronic waste program, targeting everything from power tools with embedded batteries to video game consoles.

item.title: Precision Assembly and Testing with Electric Torque Control
item.description: Modern manufacturing demands torque accuracy, traceability, and repeatability. The Promess TorquePRO delivers all three with a fully electric, programmable system designed for precision assembly and test applications across every industry.

item.title: Combining Linear and Rotational Precision in One System
item.description: Assembly processes are becoming more complex, and manufacturers need solutions that combine multiple motions without sacrificing accuracy. The Promess REMAP delivers programmable linear and rotational control in a single compact, ready to run unit.

item.title: Toyota Career Program Inspires Students to Pursue Manufacturing Careers
item.description: PRINCETON, IN—Toyota Motor Corp.’s 4T Academy encourages high school students to pursue careers in manufacturing.

item.title: Robotic Automation System Assembles Switches
item.description: The new machine replaces a legacy system that was in operation for more than 40 years, offering at least twice the throughput and close to double the efficiency of the previous equipment.

item.title: High Speed Rotary and Linear Indexing Devices
item.description: Motion Index Drives delivers high-speed cam-driven indexing solutions designed to increase throughput and accuracy in electric vehicle battery manufacturing.

item.title: Volkswagen Workers in Chattanooga Near First UAW Contract
item.description: CHATTANOOGA, Tenn. — Volkswagen and the United Auto Workers reached a tentative labor agreement late Wednesday for about 3,200 employees at the automaker’s Chattanooga, Tennessee, assembly plant, marking a milestone for the union’s Southern organizing push and delivering the first UAW contract at a Southern auto plant outside the Detroit Three.

item.title: Chassis Evolve as Electrification Matures
item.description: The placement of the battery introduces new challenges for engineers, such as packaging, structural reinforcement and crash management. Also, heavy battery packs must be offset with lighter and stronger structural components to improve cornering and suspension load.

item.title: ‘Assembly Plant of the Year’ Award Call for Nominations
item.description: CHICAGO—ASSEMBLY is seeking nominations for its 2026 Assembly Plant of the Year award.
